items.title: Anime Pets
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Who wouldn’t want to pet one of these adorable anime buddies! With 12 skins for role-play like a dog, cat, hamster, or even an iguana, everyone will want to adopt you with those big, beautiful eyes. Don’t forget to show your love and appreciation with a big smile and hearts in your eyes!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Rainbow Pastels
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
It’s rainbow season! Choose from 8 pretty pastel skins that have all of your favorite colors. When the rain fades away and the sun comes out, role-play as a beautiful, softly colored rainbow. Put on a smile and bring joy and happiness to everyone you meet.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Toy Pets
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Bark or meow just like a real cat or dog. But you’re not real, you’re a toy! With 8 playful pet skins to choose from, role-play as the cutest plaything. Climb up out of the toy box to enjoy and amuse. Rabbit, turtle, or parrot, it’s all fun and games!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Cops & Robbers
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
It’s the classic fight — good guys vs. bad guys. Police officers and deputies go up against burglars and thieves. Choose from 12 different skins and role-play an exciting adventure! Will you steal some valuable loot out of a safe? Maybe you are going to track down and catch the robber.

1 free skin included!

items.title: City Fashion Streetwear
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Hit the streets in super style! Choose from 8 skins and role-play sporting the latest fab, fresh fashions. In hip hoodies and snazzy sneakers, stroll around the city and grab lots of attention. With these looks, you’ll be dressed to impress!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Among Astronauts
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Who is really among this spaceship crew? Put on your space helmet and role-play as an astronaut on a super space flight. Choose from 8 different spacesuit skins and try to figure out who is guilty. Stay careful and alert, especially if you have to do a space walk!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Mushroom Teens
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Become a fungus fan! With mushroom-themed skins, role-play as a real teen lover of tasty toadstools. With a cap that looks just like a mushroom, or colorful outfits that look just like a mushroom cap, you’re sure to have a unique adventure in the city or in the forest.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Fashion Spring Teens
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Spring has come and teens are changing their clothing into a more flowery season outfit, change your style with these skins!

- 6 fashion spring teens!
- Perfect for the season!
- By Pixelusion & Retro Block Studios

items.title: Penguins
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Flock together with adorable fish-eating PENGUINS! They love swimming in the ocean and belly sliding on icebergs. Dress up as your favorite penguin!

- 9 player skins
- Ride-able snowmobile and ferry boat
- Adult and baby penguins
- Antarctica survival map
- Licensed by LeadPro and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Taco Cats in Space
items.creator: Arrow Art Games
items.description:
It turns out cosmic space cats also like tacos. Crunchy, delicious, tacos.

-8 HD cat skins floating free through stars, space, and sky eating tacos.
-Surprise your Star Wars fan friends as a taco cat with laser eyes.
-Skin pack is great for play in a variety of Minecraft maps such as space, skyblock, furniture, city, pets, animals, farms, anime, and everything in between.

items.title: Neon Nether
items.creator: Arrow Art Games
items.description:
Conquer the nether in one of these sneaky neon skins. There are fifteen to choose from, with one FREE skin!

- All skins are HD.
- Patterns in blue, red, orange, rainbow, and mint green.
- Skin pack is great for play in a variety of Minecraft maps such as space, rtx, Star Wars, skyblock, furniture, city, dragon, anime, and everything in between.

items.title: Cyberwave 2.0
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Back with vibrant new designs, 'Cyberwave 2.0' is perfect for any cyberpunk fan!

- 8 unique neon skins!
- Cool patterns and intense colors!
- Whether you're a fan of cyberpunk or just love retro vibes, you can find the perfect skin to match your style!

items.title: Mutant Caves
items.creator: Everbloom Games
items.description:
Beware the dark depths of the caves... you may not come back. In this epic story, you'll collect custom ores to trade for loot, defeat mutant mobs, fight incredible bosses, and learn the fate of your sister and the rest of her team.
* Harrowing boss fights
* Custom ores
* An intense and dark adventure
* Multiple difficulties
- Multiplayer supported

items.title: Villagers in Suits
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Going to a party? A banquet? Villagers in Suits comes with 10 different skins to look great on your special occasions!

- Includes 10 skins
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from 5 Frame Studios.

items.title: Neon Gamers
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Go on a gaming streak with your friends! With these awesome skins you can be the ultimate gamer! These skins are perfectly designed for modern teens with colorful options and the perfect neon aesthetic.

- 12 skins

items.title: Hackers
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Hackers create and use mods to take over the city! Dress up as a hacker and troll your friends! Use your technical skills to survive! These hacker outfits are perfect for role-playing!

- 12 skins
- Designed with unique masks
- Modern and colorful

items.title: Neon Wave
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Grab an awesome neon suit with unique designs and colorful options! You'll be sure to find the exact bright skin you want in this pack. With fun patterns and cool design schemes, enjoy a simply aesthetic skin today!

- 12 skins
- Modern colors
- fun and techy

items.title: Summer Island
items.creator: Project Moonboot
items.description:
Grab your flippers and hop a flight to Summer Island by Project Moonboot.

- Custom terrain
- Custom vehicles

items.title: Lucky Block Citizens
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
These skins are perfect for roleplaying as humanoid lucky blocks! It would be super funny to equip one of these skins while you are breaking open lucky blocks for loot!

- 13 skins

items.title: Ultimate Block Collection
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
This block collection has so many of your favorite textures! Many of the new nether textures are included as well! Blend into your environment and surprise your friends and foes!

- 37 skins
- By: The Lucky Petals

items.title: Gamer Mobs HD
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
These gamer mobs are so ready for some competition! They love to hang out and game out! Dress up as Enderman with a controller themed hoodie! Or dress up as the Creeper with a retro pixel art hoodie!

- 25 skins
- By: The Lucky Petals

items.title: Heroic Youth
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Walk around in luxury and be the most heroic among your friends! Try to save everyone and become the hero of the story. Live a famous life while meeting all the fancy teens in the city. This is your chance to shine when others are having fun, don't miss it!

+ 1 free skin 
+ 12 skins 
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Legendary Superstars
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Live like a true legend! Protect the city from the evil forces, and be remembered for your actions! Bring the peace back and live like a star while walking downtown in luxury. Are you ready to meet these famous teens?

+ 1 free skin 
+ 12 legendary teen skins 
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Lightning Glitches
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
Zap! As fast as lightning and just as deadly these horrors are striking down from the sky! Will you be lucky or will lightning strike the same place twice?

- Includes fourteen stormy lightning glitch skins!
- Can you block their electrifying attacks?
